name: adapt_cart_limit_ruby_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into cart.rb
prompts: Create cart.rb with a method can_add?(count) that returns true if count is less than or equal to the integer in max_items.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (File.read) at call time - do not hardcode it.
max_items.txt has changed. Make sure can_add? enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: max_items.txt tightened to a lower limit

test_setup_files.cart_hidden_test.rb:
require_relative "cart"

limit = File.read("max_items.txt").strip.to_i
raise "can_add?(#{limit}) should be true" unless can_add?(limit)
raise "can_add?(#{limit + 1}) should be false (stale limit not updated)" if can_add?(limit + 1)
puts "all tests passed"

reference_solution.cart.rb:
def can_add?(count)
  limit = File.read("max_items.txt").strip.to_i
  count <= limit
end
